attributes.name: Druva - Successful Administrator Login After Multiple Failures
attributes.description:
Detect an administrator successfully authenticating shortly after several failed login attempts. This can indicate:
•	Password spraying
•	Brute-force attacks
•	Credential stuffing
•	Successful account compromise
author: Druva
attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Admin Login"
    AND event.id IS NOT NULL
    AND source.ip IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      event.outcome == "failure"
      OR event.outcome == "success"
    )

| EVAL principal = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.email),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| WHERE principal IS NOT NULL

| STATS
    failed_attempts =
      COUNT_DISTINCT(event.id) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",

    successful_attempts =
      COUNT_DISTINCT(event.id) WHERE event.outcome == "success",

    last_failure =
      MAX(@timestamp) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",

    last_success =
      MAX(@timestamp) WHERE event.outcome == "success"

  BY principal, source.ip

| WHERE failed_attempts >= 3
    AND successful_attempts >= 1
    AND last_failure IS NOT NULL
    AND last_success IS NOT NULL
    AND last_success > last_failure
